name: After § 46
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 46a. Recalls that under the current seven-year financial framework, Ukraine receives an amount of EU and Member State support that is close to the regional development policy resources available to all 27 EU Member States together; expects Ukraine to refrain from attacking the national sovereignty and energy infrastructure of Member States and from interfering in national elections; condemns the fact that under the Commission’s plans for the post-2027 MFF, Ukraine would receive 20 % of the total resources allocated for the entire seven-year budget and that, according to press reports, the Commission has already accepted Ukraine’s demand for support for reconstruction and rearmament and will, as a result, provide it with an additional USD 800 billion and USD 700 billion respectively;
